import json,os,re,subprocess,stat
from pathlib import Path
projects={'Codex','VPS','fadego','iptvpn-bot','lowcost-europa','pink-iptv','skill-universal','telegram-robot-leads'}
root=Path('/srv/projects')
units=('ssh','nginx','postgresql@16-main','fadego-staging','pink-iptv-backend','pink-vpn','lowcost-europa','pm2-iptvpn-bot','pm2-telegram-robot-leads','project-secrets-offsite-backup','project-secrets-offsite-backup.timer')
out={'audit':'external-installations-and-runtime-ownership','readonly':True,'project_root_names':[],'services':{},'external_directories':{},'unit_app_paths':{},'cross_project_links':[],'safe_scope':True}
if root.is_dir():
 out['project_root_names']=sorted(x.name for x in root.iterdir() if x.is_dir() and not x.is_symlink())
for unit in units:
 a=subprocess.run(['systemctl','is-active',unit],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=8)
 b=subprocess.run(['systemctl','cat',unit],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
 lines=[x.strip() for x in b.stdout.splitlines() if not x.lstrip().startswith('#')]
 entries=[x for x in lines if x.startswith(('ExecStart=','ExecStartPre=','WorkingDirectory=','EnvironmentFile=','ExecStop=','ExecStopPost='))]
 roots=sorted(set(re.findall(r'/srv/projects/([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)', '\n'.join(entries))))
 legacy=sorted(set(re.findall(r'/(?:opt|usr/local|srv|var/lib|var/backups|etc)/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+','\n'.join(entries))))
 legacy=[x for x in legacy if not x.startswith('/srv/projects/') and not x.startswith('/etc/systemd/') and not x.startswith('/usr/local/bin/') and not x.startswith('/usr/local/lib/') and not x.startswith('/usr/local/sbin/') and not x.startswith('/etc/nginx/')]
 out['services'][unit]={'active':a.stdout.strip(),'units_available':b.returncode==0,'project_paths':roots,'external_path_candidates':legacy[:12],'unit_has_inline_environment':any(x.startswith('Environment=') for x in lines)}
for d in ('/opt','/srv','/var/www','/var/lib','/var/backups','/usr/local/sbin','/home/ubuntu'):
 p=Path(d)
 if not p.is_dir():continue
 candidates=[]
 try:
  for x in p.iterdir():
   name=x.name
   if d=='/var/lib' and name not in ('pm2','telegram-robot-leads','iptvpn-bot','pink-vpn','pink-iptv','fadego','lowcost-europa','REA','ferrari','hopper','rea','Codex','VPS'):continue
   if d=='/usr/local/sbin' and not any(k in name.lower() for k in ('pink','fadego','iptv','telegram','lowcost','ferrari','project','rea','codex')):continue
   if d=='/home/ubuntu' and not any(k in name.lower() for k in ('pink','fadego','iptv','telegram','lowcost','ferrari','project','rea','codex')):continue
   if d=='/srv' and name=='projects':continue
   if d=='/opt' and name in ('containerd','microsoft','google','git','node','openai'):continue
   candidates.append({'name':name,'kind':'symlink' if x.is_symlink() else 'dir' if x.is_dir() else 'file' if x.is_file() else 'other','symlink_target_within_project':str(x.resolve(strict=False)).startswith(str(root)+'/') if x.is_symlink() else None})
 except OSError:pass
 out['external_directories'][d]=sorted(candidates,key=lambda x:x['name'])[:100]
# fast explicit direct project-owned symlinks
for name in projects:
 p=root/name
 if not p.is_dir():continue
 for x in p.iterdir():
  if x.is_symlink():
   dst=x.resolve(strict=False)
   if str(dst).startswith(str(root)+'/') and not str(dst).startswith(str(p)+'/'):
    out['cross_project_links'].append({'project':name,'name':x.name,'target_project':dst.relative_to(root).parts[0]})
print(json.dumps(out,separators=(',',':')))
